load_failed: The terminal didn't load. Refresh the page and try again.
not_in_herdr: The session isn't running in herdr
watch_only_computer: This computer only allows watching, not control
taken: Another device took control of this terminal
lost: The terminal is back to the computer's size
clipboard_denied: The browser didn't allow reading the clipboard. Paste with ⌘V / Ctrl+V.
clipboard_insecure: This page can't read the clipboard (needs HTTPS). Paste with ⌘V / Ctrl+V.
select_first: Select the text to copy first
program_copied: A program in the terminal copied to the clipboard
program_wants_copy: A program in the terminal wants to copy some text
take_control_to_paste: Take control of the terminal to paste files
switched_during_upload: The terminal changed during the upload, so nothing was pasted
released_during_upload: Control of the terminal ended during the upload, so nothing was pasted
watch_only_chosen: Watching only: another program on the computer is using this terminal
webgl_lost: GPU rendering was interrupted. Switched back to the default renderer.
webgl_unavailable: WebGL isn't available in this browser. Using the default renderer.
